guidebook.intro: Yogera ku bye wakoze leero, jjo n’edda.

tips.title: Leero: “I have eaten”
body: Ekintu ky’omaze okukola, gamba **I have** n’ekikolwa ekikyuse: **I have eaten. I have finished. I have read the book.** Okubuuza: **Have you eaten?** — **Yes, I have.**

tips.title: Jjo n’edda: “I went”
body: Ku byayita (jjo, wiiki ewedde) ebikolwa bingi byongerwako **-ed**: **work → worked**, **study → studied**. Naye ebimu bikyuka ddala, era bino olina okubikwata.

tips.title: “I was”
body: **Nnali** kiba **I was**. Ku bangi: **we were**, **they were**. **Long ago I was a student. Last year I was in Masaka.**
**I am still** kitegeeza nkyali: **I am still a student.**

culture.title: “Olidde?”
body: Mu Uganda **Olidde?** kitera okuba ngeri ya kulamusa n’okufaayo. Mu Lungereza **Have you eaten?** kiba kibuuzo kya ddala, era kitera okutegeeza nti oyita omuntu okulya naawe.
